name: Слон проти пішаків
description:
The black pawns want to capture a flag.
Your bishop is guarding the flags. It must capture the pawns before they reach a flag.

Tip!
Pay attention to the color of the bishop’s square: a bishop on a light square can never move to a dark square. Move your bishop so that it can take pawns on same-colored squares. But watch out: if the pawns are proctecting each other, the bishop cannot take.

What do you have to do?

Capture the paws before they reach a flag.
